name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, run-it-yourself tool that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narrated audio or audiobooks, all on your own computer.
buyer: A podcast network or online course creator who wants to dub existing content into other languages without paying a dubbing studio or an ElevenLabs subscription.
business_use_cases: A course creator dubs an English video course into Spanish or Portuguese using a cloned voice, reaching new markets without re-recording a single lesson.
A publisher turns a backlog of ebooks into audiobooks cheaply, using cloned narrator voices instead of hiring a voice actor per title.
A video localization agency undercuts studio dubbing pricing by running this self-hosted at scale across a client's whole video library.

money_ideas.idea: Run a content localization service: creators send a video, you return it dubbed into five languages, billed per minute of audio processed.
Offer managed hosting of the tool for studios that don't want to run their own GPUs, as a monthly plan.

steal_this: Dub one of your own YouTube videos into a second language this weekend and publish it, then measure the view lift from the new-language audience.
